title: tidymapr: Tidy Mapping, Spatial Analysis and Publication Cartography
description: tidymapr is an R package for publication-quality maps and spatial analysis in a tidy, pipe-friendly style. It provides automatic, explained map design (projection, classification, colour ramps, legends, scale bars and north arrows); reading and writing of GIS, CAD and remote-sensing formats through GDAL; fast C++ spatial statistics (kriging with measurement error, local Moran's I, Getis-Ord hotspots); terrain hydrology and spectral indices; land area by elevation (hypsometry) and climate-driven elevational range shifts; and coverage-standardised diversity surfaces with the companion package tidydiversity.
